scope: Theorem 2.2 (Weighted anticanonical approximation) of the manuscript “Integrable metrics and effectivity with controlled boundary” (preprints/Integrable-metrics-and-effectivity-with-controlled-boundary-September-26-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 068 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 79cff3abcc899987), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 6. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let Y be smooth projective and let J ≥ 0 be integral. Suppose −KY + J has a singular metric with a global strict curvature lower bound and multiplier ideal containing OY (−J). Choose a sufficiently small ample rational divisor A. For a sufficiently large divisible integer r, resolve the complete system |r(−KY + J − A)| and J by σ : Y ′ → Y , and write σ∗ |r(−KY + J − A)| = G + |Mov|. Then Ψ = G/r − σ∗J − KY ′/Y has coefficients less than one, Ψ+ is an effective klt boundary, and D0 = Ψ− is effective and supported on σ∗J and exceptional primes. Moreover D0 ∼Q KY ′ + Ψ+ + Mov/r + σ∗ A. (2.4) The rational class Mov/r + σ∗A is nef and big. If an algebraic torus acts on Y , J is invariant, and the indicated full systems are torus-stable, the resolution may be chosen equivariantly. Then G, KY ′/Y , Ψ± and D0 are invariant, and the free system |Mov| is torus-stable. Identity (2.4) is an identity of ordinary rational line bundles; it does not assert that a chosen member of either the free system or the ample class is invariant.
